text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and Sakura Laurel 
had reached the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's still New Year's. Just as I 
was about to ease myself into work mode—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go!
choice_data_list: Where to!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "To the track! Hurry, hurry!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the track we reached, there is no one 
around except Sakura Laurel and me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Remember how I said last year that I 
wanted to "watch all kinds of umamusume 
run"?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was it.
Yeah, that was the case, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why I watched so many. I watched 
footage, and tried to go to the tracks in 
person whenever I could.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And the Arima Kinen too! A fierce race 
where both Senior and Classic classes 
clash together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Among them all, my eyes concluded that 
she was the best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Step, step, step—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian." She's my classmate... and 
an incomparable runner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I always thought she was the closest to 
being the strongest of our generation. And 
yet—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it too, Trainer? The way 
Brian-chan ran when competing for the 
Junior Class championship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was late last year. A race that the 
media covered extensively.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was overwhelming that day. 
Beyond just her speed, even the aura she 
gave off seemed on a completely different 
level from the other Junior-class 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I went back and rewatched her old race 
footage. And around November, her running 
suddenly shifted into what it is now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...That running is incredible. It's not 
just that the form is unique."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As if something far purer lay hidden 
within—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian dashed off. Sinking low to 
the earth, as if gliding across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrendering one's body to the wind like a 
leopard, stalking prey like a bird of 
prey... —That is running on pure instinct.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...She may be running alone right now, 
but she's even more unbelievable during 
actual races. Truly."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: She is a terrifying peer.
choice_data_list: You look more happy than scared, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell? I mean, how could I not be 
excited?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I want to run like that too! If I'm going 
to reach for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I have to learn to surpass that running.
choice_data_list: Then for Laurel, it's a run to aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It seems that way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I believe it won't just be me, 
but every Umamusume in Japan who will come 
to admire that kind of running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It made me realize... this is what it 
takes to have the caliber of a "Triple 
Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Triple Crown Umamusume"... It is a title 
bestowed upon an Umamusume who sweeps all 
three Classic races: the Satsuki Sho, 
Japan Derby, and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who hold that title are so few 
in Tracen Academy's history that they can 
be counted on one hand."
choice_data_list: Let's keep observing patiently.

Don't get so focused on watching that you 
catch a chill.

Shall we head back to the room and get 
right to researching?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Are you sure?
choice_data_list: ...? What is?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm. But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I was kind of thinking you might tell me 
to go back inside soon so I don't catch a 
cold.
choice_data_list: That's certainly a concern, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...And yet?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Sakura Laurel gaze at Narita 
Brian running on the track with glowing 
eyes of 'admiration'—"
choice_data_list:
Because I don't want to get in the way of 
you and your dreams.

Because I don't wish to disturb you while 
you're dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list:
Still, I won't let them stay long enough 
to cause any worry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then will you keep me company until my 
hands get cold?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, from New Year's Day onward, 
together with Sakura Laurel, I kept 
watching the "ideal running style" she had 
found.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll be careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the two of them stood side by side 
to watch Narita Brian's run, but—
choice_data_list: (…It really is chilly)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was still January. Standing around 
merely observing without moving would 
steadily sap away one's body heat.
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, I'm pretty sure in 
the trainer's room...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...? Trainer, what is that you're holding 
in your hand...?
choice_data_list: Wanna wear a hanten coat?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! ...Heh, fufu. And why did you bring them 
in different colors?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking I'd like to pick my 
favorite color.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take blue. Trainer, please wear 
the other one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu... We're matching♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, from New Year's Day onward, 
together with Sakura Laurel, I kept 
watching the "ideal running style" she had 
found.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Right! Plus, I got to show Trainer my 
running in person!
choice_data_list:
Plus, I'm curious about the run you 
mentioned for November!

Plus, I'm really curious about that run in 
November you mentioned!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! Ahaha... Trainer, aren't you the one 
who's actually more curious about 
Brian-chan?
choice_data_list:
Because that's the kind of running you've 
always admired!

Because it's the run you've always 
admired!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood. Let's search for lots of 
footage together then♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Laurel and I headed back to 
the Trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer. I found a new interview 
article too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see, what Brian-chan thinks is necessary 
for winter is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...A, a 'kotatsu'?
choice_data_list: If I copy her, will I get closer to Brian?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! ...Heh, fufu. Whatever are you talking 
about?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Besides, I'm already planning to watch a 
ton of race footage with Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it feels like New Year's. If 
it's in the trainer's office, why don't we 
bring it out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, from New Year's Day onward, 
snuggled under the kotatsu with Sakura 
Laurel, I kept watching the "ideal running 
style" she had found.
